scope: Same-host development baseline for inherited Forward workload, including existing postprocess; not effects-off F0, complete F0-F8, or G05/G07 qualification
legacyProtocol: framegraph-021-default-path-preflight-v1 remains unchanged and its failed evidence is retained

calibration.selection: Earliest candidate at which both successive windows have stable three-cohort CPU P95 and pooled P50/P95 drift <=5% for every case and variant; do not inspect candidate speedup to choose a warmup

coldDefinition: Fresh browser profile/device; scenario setup and explicit pipeline compilation reported separately; startup CPU consists of the first 120 runtime frames after pipeline preparation. No OS/driver cache flush or GPU-cold claim.
steadyDefinition: A single common warmup chosen from a separate complete calibration population, frozen before fresh baseline captures. Retain every warmup and measured frame; compare all 3000 CPU and 300 GPU samples per cohort.
